description.p: VoidReign is a standalone 4X space strategy game built on the OpenSE4 C++ engine. Explore a generated galaxy, develop colonies, manage resources and logistics, research technologies, design starships, establish orbital stations and command fleets across star systems.
The game ships with its own rules and content. A separate legacy compatibility mode can read a player's own installed Space Empires IV data, but that is not required to play VoidReign.
VoidReign is currently in active development. Features and content are still being implemented and verified.
First standalone VoidReign engine/content bootstrap. Not yet a complete playable release.
